PRIOR-PERIOD CORRECTION (ASC 250-10-45-23, 250-10-50-7). Pinecone Dental Group C-025: Amendment No. 1 (documents/month_07/order_form_amendment_C-025.md, signed by both parties, effective 2025-07-02) corrects a clerical error in the 2025-02-01 order form: the 36,000.00 fee is an annual platform subscription with a 12-month term 2025-02-01 through 2026-01-31, and there never were implementation services (consistent with the Feb client answer F2: 'nothing bespoke - they self-onboarded like everyone else'). The series of daily subscription services was being satisfied over time from 2025-02-01 (ASC 606-10-25-14(b), 25-27), so the prior position that no term was determinable (F1/F4, U10) no longer holds on the documented record: 36,000/12 = 3,000.00 was earned each month Feb-Jun 2025 but not recognized. Result: 4000 revenue understated and 2200 contract liability overstated by 5 months x 3,000.00 = 15,000.00 at 06/30/2025. Corrected in the July books as a separately identified prior-period entry; the monthly books are interim statements issued to the Board, so the ASC 250 disclosure is made in month_07/open_items.md and the correction is visible as its own journal entry rather than buried in July releases. Alternative characterization - a change in estimate when the term became determinable, recognized as a cumulative catch-up in the period of change - yields identical July amounts (this 15,000.00 catch-up plus the 3,000.00 July service month in JE-2507-013); July 4000 impact is 18,000.00 either way. Cash was collected in Feb 2025: no A/R or cash impact. U10 CLOSED by the documented amendment.
